biography:
Infrastructure executive with 28+ years driving large-scale, capital-intensive data center programs from concept through steady-state operations. Career portfolio includes $28B+ in mission-critical program value across hyperscale, colocation, and build-to-suit environments — including a $21B, 2-gigawatt landmark hyperscale campus. Operates at the intersection of business strategy and infrastructure execution: site selection through commissioning, capital deployment through governance, RFP through operational handover. Builds the operating models, KPI frameworks, and executive reporting cadences that drive multi-billion-dollar program delivery. Trusted advisor to hyperscale operators and Fortune 100 owners. Published author of The Mission is Critical: Mastering Hyperscale Data Center Construction (2024). Recognized industry SME and LinkedIn Top Voice in Business & Project Management. Civic service: Town of Flower Mound, TX — Zoning Board of Adjustment & Oil & Gas Board of Appeals
Since entering the trades in the late 90s, I have built a sterling reputation across the commercial and industrial construction sectors-emerging as a pioneer not only in traditional construction but also in the rapidly evolving AI industry. My hands-on experience in fabrication and project management laid the foundation for a career defined by technical innovation and strategic problem-solving.

Over the past 26 years, I have served as a trusted advisor and consultant for some of the biggest names in the hyperscale and industrial sectors, consistently delivering solutions that address both financial and technical challenges. As a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the mission-critical space, I excel at pinpointing root causes and implementing strategies that drive success for large-scale projects.

I founded Just Electric NYC, one of New York City's fastest-growing electrical contracting firms, where I blended my construction expertise with insights from my law studies to anticipate challenges and manage projects proactively. This approach-integrating traditional methods with AI-driven innovations-has been instrumental in delivering projects on time and within budget.

My career has also embraced public service and political leadership. I have run for various political offices, including a gubernatorial bid in New York, reflecting my commitment to community development and public policy. After relocating to Texas, I continued this tradition by serving on the Board of Adjustments in Flower Mound for one year, further demonstrating my dedication to civic engagement.

In addition to my technical and political pursuits, I have authored books aimed at mentoring others in the industry. My diverse career is a testament to my unwavering commitment to innovation, leadership, and advancing the fields of construction and AI-driven solutions.
